claims.statement: JFrog documents a Reference Token as a shortened string that refers to an actual longer access token, usable as a basic-auth password or in the X-JFrog-Art-Api header, and states that reference tokens start with cmVmd.

sources.supports: "Reference tokens follow this pattern: .*\bcmVmd[A-Za-z0-9]{59}\b.*, starting with cmVmd and including 59 alphanumeric characters"
sources.locator: section "Comparing Identity Reference Tokens With API Keys"

sources.supports: Reference Token described as a "shortened," 128-character key providing an alias for a longer token (Artifactory 7.38.4 onward); can be used instead of a password for basic authentication
sources.locator: sections "Create an Admin Scoped Reference Token" and "Basic Authentication"

claims.statement: Gitleaks (jfrog.go, rule jfrog-identity-token) and TruffleHog (artifactoryreferencetoken detector), maintained separately, both treat a JFrog reference/identity token as a 64-character alphanumeric value: Gitleaks as a keyword-gated 64-character alphanumeric run, TruffleHog as the literal prefix cmVmdGtu followed by 56 alphanumeric characters. This is consistent with the 64-character length on the provider Identity Tokens page and not with the 128-character figure on the Access Tokens page; it is not the provider's rule.

sources.supports: rule jfrog-identity-token uses a 64-character alphanumeric capture, gated by the keywords jfrog, artifactory, bintray, xray (no prefix in the rule)
tokenPat matches cmVmdGtu followed by 56 alphanumeric characters, commented as 64 characters total

claims.statement: TruffleHog's artifactoryreferencetoken detector uses the 8-character prefix cmVmdGtu, a refinement of the documented cmVmd; no second independent artifact was found that states it, so this is a lead only.

sources.supports: tokenPat literal prefix cmVmdGtu; comment says it is the base64 encoding of a six-letter string

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Candidate established at existence level only; format, variants, benign siblings and lifecycle are not researched.

Two provider pages disagree on length: Access Tokens says 128 characters, Identity Tokens says 64 (cmVmd plus 59 alphanumerics). Two independent scanner rule artifacts are consistent with 64 (a tool-corroborated claim, not a provider statement), so the conflict is not settled by the provider. Whether the 128-character figure describes a different form or is stale is unresolved; no structure length is recorded.

Identity tokens are documented as an access token scoped to a user, and the identity reference token is a reference token. Whether identity reference tokens are the same family as admin-scoped reference tokens is unresolved.
